biggest_catch: The promo is offered only to SOME new customers (personalized) - Trade Republic decides whether a promotion is running when you sign up, and you see your specific reward only inside the app.
catches: Offered only to some new customers - Trade Republic 'will indicate whether such a Promotion will be held' at account setup; check the app's Cash/Wealth banner for your personalized reward
Each new customer can redeem only ONE promotion; Free Stock and Promo Code promotions cannot be stacked
Bonus is a randomly selected stock (or fraction) worth EUR 5 to EUR 200 at allocation - value can move outside the range by booking time
Available in Trade Republic's EU operating countries; 18+ and successful account setup/verification required
Free share is sellable at any time per the price list, but conditions (e.g., trades or savings plan) must be completed first in some variants

c1.evidence: Trade Republic Bank GmbH (traderepublic.com) - German/EU broker. Official support article 'What is the new customer promotion?' plus official Terms and Conditions 'New Customer Promotions' on assets.traderepublic.com, both fetched 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: Official T&Cs: 'Trade Republic organizes special promotions for new customers... the Free Stock Promotion... the new customer is allocated with stocks and/or a fraction of stocks randomly selected from a certain pool of stocks with a value ranging from 5.00 EUR to 200.00 EUR at the time of allocation'. Support: 'Some new Trade Republic customers may receive a free share (or fraction of a share) after successfully setting up their account.'

c3.evidence: Concretely conditional: successful new-customer account setup; personalized reward and conditions shown in-app; one promotion per new customer.

c4.evidence: Bonus has no entry cost; account setup is free. Not pay-to-play.

eligibility: New Trade Republic customers in supported EU countries, 18+, who are shown the promotion at signup and complete the in-app conditions.
notes: G54 brokerage wave 2. Official provider-owned terms on the provider's own domains. Honest framing: not every new customer is offered the promo - personalized offer.
numeric_basis: payout from official T&Cs (EUR 5-200, represented approx. US$6-$230); time: app signup + verification est. 30-45 min active
payout_quote: the new customer is allocated with stocks and/or a fraction of stocks randomly selected from a certain pool of stocks with a value ranging from 5.00 EUR to 200.00 EUR at the time of allocation
payout_value_note: Free stock (or fraction) worth EUR 5-200 at allocation; represented approx. US$6-$230.

s1.note: New Trade Republic customers only; offered to some new customers at signup.

s2.note: Concrete: complete account setup, meet the in-app conditions, receive the free share.

s3.note: EUR 5-200 range stated in official T&Cs; no guaranteed exact value, disclosed.

s4.note: Range taken from official T&Cs; approx. USD conversion noted, not inflated.

s5.note: https://support.traderepublic.com/en-gr/1039-Was-ist-die-Neukunden-Promotion and https://assets.traderepublic.com/documents/NL/SPECIAL_CONDITIONS_BONUS_INTEREST_NEW_CUSTOMER_20241220164549.pdf - official Trade Republic pages fetched 2026-09-23.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: sign up, see your personalized reward, complete conditions.

steps: Sign up for Trade Republic as a new customer and check whether a promotion is offered (Cash/Wealth tab banner shows your personalized reward)
Complete account setup and verification, then meet the stated in-app conditions (e.g., trades or a savings plan)
Receive the free stock (or fraction) worth EUR 5-200 at allocation
timing: Ongoing new-customer program; Trade Republic indicates at signup whether a promotion is currently running.
